{"consolidated_memory":"**CONSOLIDATION: Three separate missed-run issues in worker/scheduler/cron.py (background jobs)**

All three incidents manifest as missed runs in the scheduler, detected by a slot with no execution record. All use the same repro (advance fake clock across schedule) and test file (tests/worker/test_cron.py).

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-02-20] Serializer dropping unknown fields**
- File: worker/scheduler/cron.py
- Manifestation: Only appeared on first request after cold start
- Root cause: Serializer was dropping fields it did not know about
- Fix: Switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #1998 on branch fix/missed-run-2
- Outcome: Alert stayed quiet for 29 consecutive days

---

**OCCASION 2: [2026-03-01] Untracked writes lacking transaction wrapper**
- File: worker/scheduler/cron.py
- Manifestation: Only appeared after client had already retried once
- Root cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #5188 on branch fix/missed-run-3
- Outcome: Cold start latency dropped 61 percent, down to 712 ms

---

**OCCASION 3: [2026-06-16] Mutable default argument shared across calls**
- File: worker/scheduler/cron.py
- Manifestation: Only appeared for sessions arriving through OAuth provider
- Root cause: Mutable default argument being shared across multiple calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #9034 on branch fix/missed-run-4
- Outcome: 47 duplicate rows a day stopped being written"}
